title: The Last Space Cop in the Galaxy
description: Richard Rider is the only Nova Corps officer left alive, and the thing that killed everyone else is punching through the edge of the universe.
hook_note: Opening on a named human hero declared 'last survivor' instantly frames one person in maximum trouble.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Meet our boy Rich - Richard Rider, the last Nova Corps officer left breathing.

segments.text: Meet our boy Rich - Richard Rider, the last Nova Corps officer left breathing.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And the thing that killed the rest? It punched straight through the edge of the universe.

segments.text: And the thing that killed the rest?
It punched straight through the edge of the universe.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: That edge is called the Crunch, which means these guys came from outside reality itself.

segments.text: That edge is called the Crunch, which means these guys came from outside reality itself.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: First stop: Xandar, the Corps' homeworld, wiped off the board on day one.

segments.text: First stop: Xandar, the Corps' homeworld, wiped off the board on day one.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: They call themselves the Annihilation Wave, led by Annihilus, bug guy with a god complex.

segments.text: They call themselves the Annihilation Wave, led by Annihilus, bug guy with a god complex.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And yeah - Annihilation Wave, Annihilus. Rich admits not everyone connected those dots.

segments.text: Rich admits not everyone connected those dots.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: His whole deal? Our universe is expanding into his Negative Zone, so he's taking it back.

segments.text: His whole deal? Our universe is expanding into his Negative Zone, so he's taking it back.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Six months later, Rich and whatever's left are dug in on Daedalus 5.

segments.text: Six months later, Rich and whatever's left are dug in on Daedalus 5.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: For once they're actually holding the line, and Rich says he'll take what he can get.

segments.text: For once they're actually holding the line, and Rich says he'll take what he can get.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: His number two is Quill, who absolutely thinks he's the main character.

segments.text: His number two is Quill, who absolutely thinks he's the main character.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Rich asks him to lie, so Quill dryly promises the force fields will hold - happy now?

segments.text: Rich asks him to lie, so Quill dryly promises the force fields will hold - happy now?

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Running her own hit-and-run ops out there is Gamora, deadliest woman in the galaxy and aware of it.

segments.text: Running her own hit-and-run ops out there is Gamora, deadliest woman in the galaxy and aware of it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Quill reports she's still singing the same song - bring the fight to them, in C minor.

segments.text: Quill reports she's still singing the same song - bring the fight to them, in C minor.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Rich flatly tells him to throw the C minor bit back out. Comedy king, no.

segments.text: Rich flatly tells him to throw the C minor bit back out. Comedy king, no.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Then Quill spots something across the battlefield and mutters, 'That can't be good.'

segments.text: Then Quill spots something across the battlefield and mutters, 'That can't be good. '

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Rich yells for a plain answer, so Quill screams the right flank barricades just blew.

segments.text: Rich yells for a plain answer, so Quill screams the right flank barricades just blew.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And when one goes, the whole grid cascades - meaning the force fields are about to fail.
